We can see mountains, oceans and clouds.
There are large oceans on Earth.
It looks like a big blue marble.
Earth also has some beautiful names.
For example, the Blue Planet and Mother Earth.
I want to know more about our Mother Earth!
What can Mike and Amy see in the sky?
It talks about things on Mars.
Is there any water on Mars?
They say there aren't any living things.
This is the sunrise on Mars.
I really want to travel to Mars.
Maybe you can go one day.
China already put a rover on Mars.
We learn more about the "red planet" every year.
What else do you know about Mars?
I can see Earth and the Sun.
Do you know any Chinese astronauts?
What do you know about an astronaut's life in space?
Their life in space is special.
The taikonauts get up early in the moming.
They can't use water to wash their faces.
So talkonauts have to use a wet cloth.
They brush their teeth with a special toothpaste and have to "eat"it!
Each day the taikonauts are very busy.
They do a lot of work.
For example, they grow vegetables and rice.
Sometimes, they also give classes to children and answer questions about space.
Every afternoon they do exercise to keep healthy and strong.
But their job is also very interesting.
They con see the sunrise and sunset 16 times a day.
There is no other job like this one.
What do taikonauts do for children?

The closest planet to the Sun is not the hottest.
The hottest planet is Venus, It has a temperature ( ) of about 467°C.
Jupiter's storm may be more than 300 years old.
The name of the big storm on Jupiter is the Great Red Spot.
Neptune has the fastest wind in the solar system Neptune's winds can reach over 2,000 kilometres per hour.
Is there any water on these planets?
So there are no fish out there.
Scientists are still looking for them.
Are there any footprints on the Moon?
Footprints on the Moon could stay there for a very long time.
They could be there for thousands of years!
There are thousands of pieces of space junk floating around Earth.
Space junk is man-made objects left in space.
What other facts do you know?

reading.text: Maybe we can talk about water power.
Let's find out more about water power.
What do you know about it?
We can get power from the sea too.
What else do you want to know about water?
Well, where does water come from?
How do we make power from water?
We can work on it together.
What did they choose for their project?
What does Binbin want to know about it?
Water comes from rivers, lakes and seas.
What do I want to know?
How much fresh water does Earth have?
What makes some rivers and lakes dry up?
Do Binbin and Mike think it's too late to change?
But many resources are running out.
Then we will use fewer resources.
We should change our energy use.
Can you give us an example, Binbin?
That will save energy and water.
We can also use LED lighting.
And we should always unplug our computers and TVs.
Small changes can make a big difference.
Why do we have to save energy?
What did Binbin and Mike suggest?
We should turn off the lights.
What energy do you often use every day?
Mother Earth is running out of resources!
Here are our top three ideas.
We should all try to save energy and save our Earth!
Wash all your dirty dothes together, not one at a time.
Wash fruit and vegetables, then use the water again.
Think: How does a quick shower save energy?
Turn off your TV or computer and unplug it.
Set your air conditioner to 26℃ or more in summer.
Think: How can you use air conditioners less?
You can put noodles or pencils in them.
Think: What are your ideas for following the "3R"rules?
Do small things to save water.
Send your ideas to the magazine.
How can we all help Mother Earth?
We are running a competition to find some helpful ideas from our readers.
Please write to us and let us know your ideas and tips.
We are running out of resources.
But it is not too late.
We can do things to change this.
Grandpa, Binbin and Robin played outside.
They didn't want to go back to the kitchen to cook lunch.
Grandpa had an idea. "The sun is very hot.
We can use solar power to cook our lunch here," he said. "Let's make a solar oven!" So, they did.
